marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Wind west 15 to 20 knots diminishing to light this afternoon
then increasing to east 15 Saturday morning. Wind increasing to east 25 to 30
Saturday evening. Scattered flurries ending this evening with a risk of
freezing drizzle. Scattered flurries Saturday afternoon and
evening. Temperatures near minus 3. <br/>
